comment: Single source of truth for inventory query tools exposed through MCP and backend-only display tools exposed to Bedrock. Backend schemas cover all 7 tools; the MCP server registers only the 5 query tools.

search_inventory.comment: Each entry must carry item_id (per-unit identifier) in addition to id (card_id). Council r1 item 1 FATAL: one card_id can map to multiple physical units, so the producer must emit item_id for the consumer (display_card) to hydrate the exact unit.
